clips.title: The story
paras: Golnir Bouldertoe is a dwarven mining vendor stationed beside the bustling Great Forge in Ironforge. He provides essential supplies for miners and prospectors while handling dispatches for local couriers and travelers.

Standing within the roaring heat of Ironforge's Great Forge, Golnir Bouldertoe outfits prospectors and craftsmen with the necessities of their trade. From sturdy mining picks to fluxes and coal, his wares fuel the tireless smelting fires and smithies that define the dwarven capital. Kin to Geofram Bouldertoe, Golnir is a reliable point of contact for workers arriving in the city, often directing fresh hands or receiving supply missives shuttled in from nearby outposts.
